title: Incident workbench
pitch: Click a sample and the chart follows, drag the split, zoom with the wheel, then work the runbook, all with the mouse or the keys.
makeItYours: Load your own samples: a service's latency, a queue's depth, a build's duration.
Turn your team's runbook into outline entries, with a toggle for each step.
Give the grid and the chart the same link key and keep their rows in the same order.
useCase: Use it when someone needs to read a spike, find the moment it started and work a checklist without leaving the terminal.
